also_today.headline: Russian strikes kill 15 in Kyiv region; flats collapse in Dymer.
US sanctions Iran's shadow banks: two dozen exchange houses hit.
Mexico captures 'El Chapo Isidro' and vows to try him at home.

notes: COP31's final plenary collapsed on Sunday 22 Nov (Antalya time); it led Monday 23 Nov's news cycle worldwide. The Indonesia fire broke out Saturday 21 Nov; the toll of 24 dead was confirmed on Monday 23 Nov. The Libya strike happened before dawn Sunday; Zelensky confirmed it on Monday 23 Nov.

stories.headline: Huang is back as Nvidia CEO
stories.summary: Reinstated 11 days after quitting; shares soar 33%, Nasdaq jumps 6%.

stories.headline: Ukraine sinks Russian warship off Libya
stories.summary: Seven sea drones sink the corvette Merkury at Benghazi; a cargo ship is hit too.

stories.headline: COP31 ends with no climate deal
stories.summary: After record overtime in Antalya, nations reject a pact with no fossil-fuel plan.

stories.headline: 24 dead in Indonesia factory fire
stories.summary: Blaze guts a sweets factory in Banten; about 30 workers still missing.

stories.headline: US blacklists Megaspeed
stories.summary: Singapore chip firm accused of diverting AI chips to China joins the Entity List.

stories.headline: EU unveils 22nd Russia sanctions
stories.summary: 60 banks cut from SWIFT, a crypto task force, and no Russian flag at EU sport.
